summary.name: FontForge
summary.one_liner: FontForge is a free, open-source outline font editor for creating and editing fonts.
keywords: free alternative to commercial font editors
use_cases: Getting help with font editing via mailing list
Contributing to an open-source font tool
summary.what_it_does: The page describes FontForge as a free and open source font editor maintained by a community of type enthusiasts. It points new users to the "Design With FontForge" guide and the project documentation as starting points. Help is available through a mailing list when documentation and web searches do not answer a question. The project accepts financial donations, and it invites non-programmers as well as developers to contribute, via a developer mailing list.
notable: Free and open source outline font editor
Community-driven project with mailing list support
Listed as freeware/open-source in awesome-mac Design Tools
caveats: Supported platforms are not named on the page
Page is mostly links and community information with few technical details
